description: Creation of external seating area comprising 12 tables and 24 chairs and installation of 8 non-illuminated branded barriers
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (FIV220-P212, FIV220-P213, FIV220-P413, FIV220-P414, FIV220-P422, Location Plan and Block Plan; Eclipse Furniture details; Received 26/02/20) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The front external seating and barriers hereby approved shall only be sited in front of the unit during its operational hours and shall be fully removed and taken indoors outside of the operational hours and shall not be left outside.

Condition : 4 - The front external seating and pedestrian barriers hereby approved shall only include the submitted products: 12 x tables, 24 x Chairs and 8 x Barriers as detailed by drawings hereby approved.
